text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application by the owner(s) of 37 York Ridge Road to allow the north most patio doors of the rear dwelling outside of the patio to be sealed and become a part of the wall of the rear dwelling therefore not allowing direct access to pool area. This is contrary to the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447.1.3(C)3 Access Protection.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item until the December 3, 2024 meeting of North York Community Council.
